about: Known-answer testbed results: each scoring channel run on a library whose true hits are known, with every metric re-expressed as a percentile of that library's own permutation null. The underlying libraries are not redistributed (see DATA.md); only aggregate metrics are shown here.

null.construction: 1000 noise rankings of the library, metrics computed on each; the null depends only on (n_total, n_hits).
null.percentile_definition: percentage of null draws less than or equal to the observed value (100.0 = at or above every draw)
null.note: These percentiles were computed against nulls drawn on each library's real label vector. A null regenerated from counts alone (scripts/empirical_null.py, summarized in results/empirical_null.json) agrees to within about 3 percentile points; the discrete metrics (EF@50, EF@1%) differ most.

WDR91.target_note: WD40-repeat protein-protein-interaction surface groove; shallow, no bridging waters in the reference pocket.

confounds: thinner model than a water-mediated pocket would give: no bridging-water or selectivity-residue points
shallow groove is a poorer fit for a pharmacophore than an enclosed pocket

library.kind: shortlist: all known hits plus a seeded random sample of non-hits

ErG similarity to the co-crystal ligand.caveat: The anchor is anti-correlated with this library's hits (hit-to-anchor similarity at the 1.3rd percentile of a random-draw null; results/hit_structure_followups.json), so any anchor-similarity ranking fails here by construction. This is not independent evidence about ErG as a method.

library.kind: shortlist: all known hits plus a seeded random sample of non-hits

DDB1.target_note: Full-length construct (UniProt Q16531, residues 1-1140). Boltz-2 was not run on this target.

ErG similarity to the co-crystal ligand.caveat: LogAUC sits in the extreme tail of its own null, so this control is not clean. A hit-clustering test and an ECFP4 anchor-similarity test did not explain it (results/hit_structure_followups.json); an explanation in ErG's own feature space was not tested.

reading_notes: EF@50 is coarse and noisy at low hit counts: at 19 hits among 15,419 compounds, landing one hit in the top 50 by chance happens about 6% of the time. The pharmacophore's EF@50 sits at only the 94.3rd percentile, while its LogAUC and EF@1% are at or above essentially every null draw.
EF@1% is also discrete at these sizes (the median null value is 0); LogAUC is the most informative single metric here.
